# AWS Blocks

Domain expertise for building full-stack applications using AWS Blocks — a serverless-first approach to application development.

## When to Use

- Building new full-stack applications from scratch
- Migrating existing apps to AWS Blocks architecture
- Designing event-driven serverless architectures
- Composing reusable app components on AWS

## Key Concepts

| Concept | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| App Component | Reusable UI/business logic module |
| Data Source | API endpoint connected to AWS data services |
| Deployment | Push-based deployment with preview environments |
| Composition | Combining multiple components into cohesive apps |

## Common Patterns

1. **Start with the user flow** — Map out key screens and actions before choosing services
2. **Compose, don't monolith** — Break features into independent blocks that can be developed and deployed separately
3. **Leverage managed services** — Prefer fully managed AWS services over self-managed alternatives
4. **Plan for scale early** — Serverless scales automatically but design data access patterns carefully
